Recipe.Title: SkyBricate recipe rules
Recipe.Hint: These rules belong to the saved recipe shown below. Save them separately; unsaved Fabricate recipe edits are not included. Closing discards unsaved rule edits.

Recipe.LimitByCheck: Limit property count by check outcome
Recipe.OutcomeHint: One shared maximum of distinct properties per native outcome; 0 allows none. Strength sets essenceQuantity for each selected property, not the number of properties. Default: 1.
Recipe.NoOutcomes: No stable check outcomes are available: turn off the count limit. Without a check, each property has strength 1, regardless of ingredient quantity.
Recipe.InvalidLimit: Enter a non-negative safe integer for every outcome.
Recipe.Unavailable: This window lost its manager context or GM access. Reopen rules from the recipe row.
Recipe.Strength: Strength of each property (independent of count limit)
Recipe.InvalidStrength: Enter a positive finite strength for every outcome.
